hypotheses.statement: Heater has positive steady-state gain: higher constant u yields higher equilibrium y.
Step response has appreciable lag/delay: y takes tens to hundreds of seconds to approach equilibrium.
No large dead zone: even u=0.3-0.5 produces a clear rise compared to u=0.
At u=0, y decays on its own toward low ambient near 0-0.1 due to heat loss.
Steady-state gain is approximately linear in u across 0 to 1.
Constant u near 0.5 holds y near target 0.5 at equilibrium.
Sensor noise and short-term fluctuations are small (<~0.01) compared to control band width 0.05.
